description.en: Defines the €250,000 reference-income threshold above which a single taxpayer becomes liable for France's exceptional contribution on high incomes (Contribution Exceptionnelle sur les Hauts Revenus, CEHR). It sets a Band_UpLim edge in tin_fr's SchedCalc that computes the CEHR ("Exceptional contributions on high income earners: singles"), and the same value is reused as the Elig_Cond eligibility threshold for singles in tinto01_fr, which screens taxpayers into the related Contribution Différentielle sur les Hauts Revenus (CDHR). The country report confirms both the CEHR and the CDHR apply above this €250,000 (singles) / €500,000 (couples) reference-income threshold.

explanation.en: EUROMOD function group: Parameters for exceptional contributions on high income
